hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */frontend/*.ts|*/frontend/*.tsx|*/frontend/*.css) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/frontend" && npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" && npx --no-install eslint --fix "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */backend/*.java) google-java-format --replace "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */deepagent-service/*.py) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/deepagent-service" && uv run ruff format "$f" && uv run ruff check --fix "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
